candidates.title: Product Designer (temporary) at Assai Software
candidates.description: We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer, to temporarily support our team (+/- 6 months). In this role you are responsible for ensuring that Assai products solve meaningful customer problems while delivering intuitive, efficient and engaging user experiences.You combine customer research, product discovery, UX design and UI design to shape products from concept through delivery and continuous improvement. Working closely with Product Managers, customers and engineers, you translate customer needs and business objectives into coherent product experiences and measurable outcomes.You contribute to developing, shaping and articulating product vision, strategy, objectives and goals. Through customer interviews, contextual inquiry, workflow analysis, usability testing and product data, you identify unmet needs, validate assumptions and provide evidence that informs product priorities and decisions. You create and validate user journeys, information architectures, interaction models, prototypes, design systems and visual interfaces. You champion customer-centered thinking and help establish consistent research, discovery and design practices across Assai. What you'll doAs a Product Designer, you’ll help shape complex enterprise products from early discovery through to production.
